product_metadata.title: VENO 4 Pack Heavy Duty Extra Large Clear Storage Bag, Moving Bag, Clothes Organizer, for Blanket, Comforter, Bedroom Closet, Dorm Room Essentials, Moving Supplies, Storage Tote, Reusable and Sustainable (Clear - Set of 4)
features: LARGE CAPACITY: 29" W X 12" H X 15" D - 86 Liters or 23 Gallon volume. Extra-large and spacious to store plenty of various sized items such as clothes, toys, linens, blankets, laundry, souvenirs, shoes, bedding, comforters, sheets, pillows, towels, accessories, decorations, curtains, gear, and more. A unique 2-sided zipper design allows the bag to open wide for easy loading and unpacking.

DURABLE SEE-THROUGH DESIGN: A clear, transparent design allows you to easily see what is inside the bag. Just peek and conveniently spot what you are looking for. Made of a unique, water-resistant, durable, premium polypropylene woven fabric material that is built to last. High-grade and puncture-resistant material protects your items from water, dust, humidity, and other damage. Easy to clean with wipes or damp cloth.

REINFORCED WRAP AROUND HANDLES: Heavy duty, strong, and thick webbing handles wrap around and under the bag for increased strength, heavy duty usage, and maximum security. Additionally, the reinforced, cross-stitched, long carrying handles are sewn with 3 layers of sturdy fabric to increase load bearing capacity for heavy loading without breaking or tearing. A 2-way, dual-tab, smooth sliding, strong zipper closure prevents items from falling out. Sturdy construction safely holds 50 lbs.

MOVING BOX ALTERNATIVE: A lightweight, economical, convenient alternative to moving boxes, bins, or containers. No extra packing supplies are needed. Just unfold, unzip, and begin packing. Essential for transporting clothes without having to remove the hangers. Collapsible and folds flat into a small size for future use and easy storage in your drawer, closet, car, or luggage.

MULTI-PURPOSE: Ideal for moving, storage, travel, camping, transporting, room organization, and space saving. Perfect for moving into your new home, apartment, or college dorm, storing your seasonal clothing and blankets, and packing clothes or bedding for your latest road trip. The bag is stackable to maximize space and makes for easy moving or storing.
